_comment: Reference data mirroring firmware/lib/CarSentinelCommon/HardwareProfiles.cpp. Not loaded from disk by firmware — pin tables are compiled in (Section 49 allows board-level pin definitions to require a rebuild). This file exists so the pin data is reviewable without reading C++.
status: camera/SD pins are the well-established public reference pinout (see docs/wiring/ESP32_CAM.md) — RCWL/DHT GPIOs below are null because they are not yet bench-verified
